reserveReview.reviewer: OpenAI Codex Safety Score V9 curation
reserveReview.rationale: Midas describes mF-ONE as indirect exposure to Fasanara Capital's diversified private-credit and digital-asset strategy. The product is a NAV-based tokenized investment strategy rather than a cash-pegged token, so the reserve is represented as one strategy exposure without inventing underlying borrower, asset, or venue weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Midas mF-ONE product disclosure and strategy description
